title: Add parser fixture and boundary/error tests
acceptance_criteria: A text fixture derived from the source ODT contains all 20 exercise records and the report-level sections needed to exercise exclusions.
Tests verify that exactly 20 records are parsed from the source fixture and that record names and ids are not duplicated at the parser boundary.
Tests verify list parsing for muscles, specific muscles, steps, common errors/corrections, tags, and sources.
Tests verify introductory, monitoring/referral, and references content is not emitted as an exercise record.
Tests verify incomplete records are rejected rather than silently returned.
